card.name: Units and timing right before thresholds
card.fires_on: Partway through a unit or timing phrase just before a numeric threshold, such as the m of mIU after a TSH value, mc before g, or 'after' following a number of months.

modes.label: TSH units
modes.description: The m in mIU/L right after a TSH number in thyroid dosing text.
modes.example: serum TSH to decrease below 20<< m>>IU per litre within 4 weeks may

modes.label: Interval after product
modes.description: The word 'after' following a time span before a biologic product is named.
modes.example: Defer vaccination with live virus vaccines until approximately three months<< after>> administration of VIGIV.

modes.label: Dose unit pieces
modes.description: Pieces of dose or level expressions such as mcg or a percent range.
modes.example: Patients in the BMT studies received up to 138 mc<<g>>/kg/day without toxic effects
